method: Freshly parsed the current web test sources with the local parser and read every extracted test title, assertion, branch, lifecycle hook, side-effect call and top-level fixture in assigned indices 0 through 34 (35 files). Re-read truncated spans of app-lifecycle, automations, input-context, memory-settings and message-media before completing. Additionally read builtin-auth, device-login, dialog, drafts and operation-generation tests completely, checking actual actions and asynchronous ordering. Reviewed login/setup and MFA secrets, stale session ownership, bounded media and URL cleanup, configuration/version consent, native handoffs, original receipt recovery, draft persistence failures, queued input context, and no hidden replay/resume. This is risk-based static test review, not full line-by-line reading of all tests and not executed verification. Tests at indices 35 through 64 are independently assigned. All frozen source hashes were checked unchanged at completion.
testExecution: No tests executed during this static review.
